info.name: Telehealth App - Layers 1-4 (sub-items 1-9)
info.description: Full API surface built through Layer 4 sub-item 7. Excludes notifications (sub-item 8) and admin (sub-item 9). Run folder-by-folder top-to-bottom: Auth first to populate tokens, then Doctors (availability -> slotId), then Appointments (booking -> appointmentId + sessionId), then Consultations. Deliberately-failing requests document the negative paths.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Registration and login. Login requests auto-populate tokens.

request.description: Expect 200; sets {{patientToken}}. 401 on bad password.

Expect 201; sets {{doctorToken}}. New doctor approvalStatus=PENDING. 409 if email taken.

item.name: Doctors
item.description: Discovery, matching, own profile, and availability management.

item.name: Consultations
item.description: Session state machine (join/complete) + notes/prescriptions (doctor-only) + records reads.

request.description: Expect 200 for a participant (SCHEDULED right after booking). 403 for a non-participant.
Expect 201; first joiner moves SCHEDULED -> JOINED. Idempotent on re-join; 409 if COMPLETED.

item.name: NEGATIVE - write note before consult is in progress

request.description: Expect 409 -- notes are only writable in IN_PROGRESS or COMPLETED (not JOINED).

exec: pm.test("note write in JOINED is rejected with 409", () => pm.response.to.have.status(409));

Expect 201 (DOCTOR-only). 400 if details empty; 409 outside IN_PROGRESS/COMPLETED.

item.name: Doctor views a patient records (related doctor)

item.name: NEGATIVE - unrelated doctor reads patient records

request.description: Expect 403 -- {{doctorToken2}} has no appointment relation with this patient.
Expect 403 -- unrelated doctor attempting to read another doctor session.
Expect 200; lists the CALLER's own notifications, newest first. Auto-sets {{notificationId}} from the first row for the mark-read request below. Empty array is valid (200).
Expect 200; marks the caller's own notification read (idempotent). id comes from GET /notifications/me via {{notificationId}}.
Expect 403; a different authenticated user cannot mark a notification they do not own as read. Uses {{notificationId}} captured by the patient above (unrelated doctorToken2 caller).

Expect 200; suspends {{targetUserId}} and writes an audit row. reason is optional. Reversible via the reactivate request below.

Expect 400; validation-parity check — the @IsNotEmpty constraint applies on the admin route exactly as on the doctor self-service route.
Expect 200; full oversight view of all appointments across patients/doctors.
Expect 200 (HttpCode(200), not 201); admin-scoped cancel of {{appointmentId}}. reason optional. Requires {{appointmentId}} set by the Appointments folder.

Expect 200; operational dashboard aggregates (counts by state/status).
Expect 200; audit log rows written by admin actions (state changes, reviews, cancels), newest first with the acting admin.
